name: SDN Host Storage Ingest Node
description: Capability node wrapping the host storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (loop C.8a): joins the parser's ingest meta JSON (schema + SourceTags provider/source/batch attribution, reconcile mode, archive naming, provenance) with the size-prefixed FlatBuffer record stream and the optional raw payload, forwards them as hostcall binary segments ({"$bin":0} records, {"$bin":1} archive raw), and emits the host's result JSON. Host-side behavior is policy-mediated by the dedicated storage_ingest capability grant (disk guardrail, batch store with source tags, source-batch reconcile, raw/provenance archiving).

externalInterfaces.description: Provenance/batch-capable record ingest through the host storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (sdn-server modulert/caps/storage.go).

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta authored by the parser node.

inputPorts.description: Ingest meta (attribution, reconcile, archive naming, provenance).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional raw source payload; archived by the host when the meta names an archive target.

methods.description: Persists one provenance-attributed record batch through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source hostcall.
